title: Remote viewers locate the MX missile every week and the program is cancelled

tellings.quote: we notified we we wrote a white paper it's called a white paper one paragraph We sent it to the Situation Room in the White House and said won't work why not because we can tell you where it is every time

plain: Psychic spies working for the US government could find the MX, a nuclear missile meant to be hidden by moving it from place to place, every time they tried, and so the plan to hide it was dropped. Joe McMoneagle, who says he took part as a remote viewer (someone trained to describe faraway places using only the mind), tells it from inside the program, which ran from about 1977 to 1989. He says they sent a one paragraph report to the White House Situation Room saying the plan "won't work" because "we can tell you where it is every time," which, if true, would mean the mind can find things no spy plane could.
